key.name: saver
key.summary: Screensaver to show
key.description: Saver id: "flurry:<preset>" (XScreenSaver's port of the original macOS Flurry; presets classic, rgb, fire, water, binary, psychedelic, insane), "xscreensaver:<hack>" or "custom:<n>".

key.name: random
key.summary: Pick a random screensaver each time (from the pool in "random-pool")

key.name: random-pool
key.summary: Where random picks come from: the favourites (all if there are none) or every screensaver

key.name: shuffle
key.summary: Play the active playlist in a random order (false: top to bottom)

key.name: favorites
key.summary: Favourite screensaver ids (marked with a star)

key.name: image-directory
key.summary: Folder of pictures for screensavers that show images ('' = their built-in image)
key.description: Searched recursively by xscreensaver-getimage (Jigsaw, Distort, GLSlideshow, ...). Desktop grabs are always off.

key.name: custom-savers
key.summary: Custom saver commands, each "Name|command line"

key.name: run-time
key.summary: Seconds to run before letting the screen blank
key.description: -1 follows GNOME's Screen Blank setting (org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay); 0 runs until a key press or click.

key.name: saver-options
key.summary: Per-screensaver option values
key.description: JSON object: saver id → { option id → value }, from each XScreenSaver hack's config XML. Only values differing from the hack's default are passed.

key.name: show-clock
key.summary: Show the time and date on the primary monitor

key.name: show-media
key.summary: Show what's playing on the primary monitor

key.name: rotate-interval
key.summary: Minutes between switching to another random screensaver (0 = never)

key.name: retrigger-delay
key.summary: Seconds of inactivity after dismissing before the screensaver returns (0 = never)
key.description: Only while the screen is still locked.

key.name: log-history
key.summary: Keep a local log of when each screensaver ran

key.name: history-limit
key.summary: How many runs the history keeps (newest first)

key.name: overlay-scale
key.summary: Size of the clock and now-playing overlay, in percent

key.name: monitor-mode
key.summary: How screensavers are spread over multiple monitors
key.description: "mirror": one screensaver, shown identically on every monitor. "same": a separate copy on each monitor. "different": each monitor gets its own pick from the source (skip changes all; timed changes are staggered).

key.name: overlay-corner
key.summary: Screen corner for the clock and now-playing overlay

key.name: antialias
key.summary: Draw OpenGL screensavers with anti-aliasing (multisampling)
key.description: Each screensaver's own Anti-aliasing option can override this.

key.name: overlay-monitor
key.summary: Monitor for the overlay, by connector name (e.g. "DP-1"); '' = primary
key.description: If that monitor isn't connected, the primary monitor is used.

key.name: playlists
key.summary: Screensaver playlists
key.description: JSON list of {"name", "savers": [saver ids]}. Whether a playlist shuffles is the "shuffle" key.

key.name: active-playlist
key.summary: Name of the playlist to use ('' = none)

key.name: skip-key
key.summary: Keyval of the key that skips to the next screensaver (0 = none)
key.description: Default is the Right arrow (0xff53). This key no longer dismisses the screensaver.

key.name: preview-request
key.summary: Internal: preview request from the preferences window
key.description: "<saver id>#<timestamp>"; writing it shows that saver until a key press or click.

key.name: enabled-on-lock
key.summary: Show the screensaver when the session locks
